_about: Optional hand-made additions, kept apart so re-running scripts/build-ph-postal.mjs never erases them. A ZIP listed here is ALWAYS accepted for that city, whatever the ZIP API says, so use it for a real ZIP the API's 2019 snapshot lacks. Key = the city's 6-digit key (first 6 digits of its PSGC code; Manila is 133900). Value = extra 4-digit ZIPs. Example: { "137501": ["1422"] } adds 1422 to Caloocan City.
